race.description: Fred Vella Tyre & Crash Repair Mdn Plate
race.comment: TASSORO (8) continues to knock on the door, turning in another good effort here last time over this trip when closing off nicely into second. Strips rock-hard fit in what looks his best chance yet. A TIME TO KILL (1) came within a long neck of the winner here two back before struggling through the slop at Balaklava last time. Willing to forgive and Callow's booking is a good push for his chances. GOODLOOKIN' GURU (10) has mixed her form since resuming but did have excuses last time. The car park draw makes things tricky but she gets in light with the 2kg claim and with a bit of luck she can give this a big shake. MANDARIN (12) shares a similar profile to those mentioned. Could easily be her day as well but she does need to find that next gear to finally break through.
